title: 1) Comprender
overview: Everything you need to set up and run the Cyber Range locally for the first time.

subsections.title: Fundamentos
subsections.content: Node.js ≥ 18 and npm ≥ 9 are required. Clone the repository and run `npm install` from the project root.

blocks.text: Node.js ≥ 18 and npm ≥ 9 are required. Check your versions with `node -v` and `npm -v` before continuing.

rows.text: Needed to clone the repository. Any recent version works.

subsections.title: Panorama de Amenazas
subsections.content: Start the development server with `npm run dev`. The app will be available at http://localhost:5173 with hot module replacement enabled.

items.title: Install dependencies
items.outcome: node_modules installed — takes ~30s on first run

items.title: Start the dev server
items.description: Hot module replacement is enabled — changes reflect instantly without a full reload.

blocks.text: Run `npm run dev -- --host` to expose the server on your local network, useful for testing on mobile devices.

subsections.title: Frameworks y Referencias
subsections.content:
The source tree follows a feature-based layout:

src/
  components/   # Shared, reusable UI components
  data/         # Static JSON / typed data files (docs, lab manifests, …)
  features/     # Feature modules (labs/, scenarios/, simulations/)
  hooks/        # Custom React hooks
  layouts/      # Page shell / persistent UI wrappers
  pages/        # Route-level page components
  router/       # Centralised routing config
  types/        # Shared TypeScript interfaces
